title: Fire, extract the spent case with held LMB, release and settle
input_audit: mg_coax is the existing capture field for ordinary LMB. The shot creates the spent chamber state, holding LMB extracts a real casing, and releasing at 4.2 seconds enters drive_casings. Only station selection and head direction use actions. No casing, inventory, breech, lever or physics state is injected.
timing_evidence: The first 4.2 seconds are unchanged from held_mouse_reload.v1.json. captures/astra/reload_case_drop_20260913_fix_manifest.json observed one shot and spent breech at 1s, one carried casing at 4s, and one uncarried active casing at 5s. That longer fixture failed later closing/second-shot checks because the loaded-round hover overrode the lever; its original assertions remain intact.
visual_acceptance: The full-size case is extracted from the open bore and stays in hand until release.
At 4.2 seconds the same case drops, contacts the compartment and remains present through the end.
Review post-release frame timing separately; state checks alone do not establish interactive frame rate.
